items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I know Wooden Joe was one of them, he was the trumpet player. And Joe liked the way I played drums.

ctx.x: Bras band. Bras band. Which brass band? Do you remember by any chance? I just...

No, right off there, no, I really don't remember. It's been quite a while. Yeah. See, because the facts like this, I hadn't took very long to start it out playing bass drum. Well, the facts, that's how I started playing drums, from a bass drum. I used to play with a little carnival band on carnival day. I had a little group, fellas with a 10-second-a-lones. Mm-hmm. And I had made up my band on carnival day. We used to play for different clubs, the Square Deal Club. We played for them one year. And from different…
